Class LessonsLearned

java.lang.Object
entityClasses.LessonsLearned
public class LessonsLearned extends Object

Title: LessonsLearned Class.

Description: Entity class representing an individual Lesson Learned. Contains core information (title, category, author, problem description, solution) and time data (timeSpentHours). Provides input validation.

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned(int lessonId, String title, String category, String author, String problemDescription, String solution, double timeSpentHours)

      Constructor: LessonsLearned(int lessonId, String title, String category, String author, String problemDescription, String solution, double timeSpentHours)

      Description: Parameterized constructor initializing a LessonLearned with core information.

      Parameters:
      lessonId - - the unique integer identifier of the lesson
      title - - the title of the lesson (must be between 5 and 100 characters)
      category - - the category of the lesson (cannot be blank)
      author - - the author/contributor username.
      problemDescription - - the description of the problem (cannot be blank)
      solution - - the description of the solution (cannot be blank)
      timeSpentHours - - the numerical effort spent in hours (must be non-negative)

    • LessonsLearned

      public LessonsLearned(int lessonId, String title, String category, String author, String problemDescription, String solution, double timeSpentHours, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String teamEffort, boolean isLocked)

      Constructor: LessonsLearned(int lessonId, String title, String category, String author, String problemDescription, String solution, double timeSpentHours, String whatWasDone, String howItWasDone, String teamEffort, boolean isLocked)

      Description: Convenience constructor for creating a new lesson prior to database ID assignment.

      Parameters:
      lessonId - - the unique integer identifier of the lesson
      title - - the title of the lesson (must be between 5 and 100 characters)
      category - - the category of the lesson (cannot be blank)
      author - - the author/contributor username.
      problemDescription - - the description of the problem (cannot be blank)
      solution - - the description of the solution (cannot be blank)
      timeSpentHours - - hours spent
      whatWasDone - - what actions were performed
      howItWasDone - - method used
      teamEffort - - team member effort breakdown
      isLocked - - overall lock status
